## Invitations

The outreach record shows that 1799 people were invited, with 1176 attending. The attendance rate was 65.4. These figures provide the recorded position for the invitation activity and indicate the level of participation during the reporting period.

Operational arrangements were maintained to support attendance. Van days were kept where roads allowed, helping to preserve access while local conditions permitted. The attendance figure reflects those who came in response to the invitations and should be read alongside the recorded outreach arrangements.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 1529 invitees. Reminder messages were also sent to 1529. The matching figures show that the reminder activity covered the same recorded group as the SMS contact. This provided a consistent means of communicating with invitees and reinforcing the invitation.

The figures in this report are based on the recorded invitations, attendance, SMS contact and reminder activity. Prepared by G. Evans.
